Execution boundary

Cube is both a semantic runtime and an acceleration layer. It owns measures, joins, multi-stage calculations, access policies, APIs, caching, and pre-aggregations; ingestion, source data quality, and consumer presentation still have separate owners.

Modeling boundary

A YAML definition cannot recover information the source discarded.

Cube can calculate exact distincts, safe ratios, rolling windows, and accelerated aggregates when the model retains the necessary grain and keys. Stored scalar counts, ambiguous repeated values, and unversioned identities still require better source contracts.
